digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary CI scheduling
propositions: Reconciler bridge cron backstop must change from 20-minute to uniform 40-minute cadence using three-entry schedule cycle (0 0-23/2, 40 0-23/2, 20 1-23/2).

Chain pacing must be implemented with self-tuning elapsed-time sleep (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s, skipped when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH unset) to double re-dispatch interval without new repo variables.
Canary schedule must change from hourly to 2-hourly, and ALERT_WINDOW_HOURS default must double from 2 to 4 hours.
Jenkinsfile must mirror the three-entry 40-minute backstop cron expression.
All documentation, comments, and test pins referencing 20-minute cadence or hourly canary must be updated to reflect new 40-minute and 2-hourly schedules.
Tests must assert uniform 40-minute gaps between fire times and validate pacing step behavior for short elapsed time, elapsed-skip threshold, and missing PASS_STARTED_EPOCH scenarios.
